name: Rio Grande do Sul historic flood

gee.note: JS can't read files — the gee/0*.js pasted bboxes/dates must mirror these values by hand. window = reference_date -/+ window_*_days (config.yaml cases.rs_2024).

nisar.note: No NISAR coverage — event predates launch (Jul 2025). Validation via OPERA DSWx-HLS and MODIS NRT Flood on cloud-free days; HLS cloud fraction quantifies what optical missed.

swot.note: Jacui main stem downstream->upstream into terminal reach 64110700015 at the Jacui delta / Guaiba head by Porto Alegre. SWORD names this stem no_data/'Taquari River', so FTS name search for 'Rio Jacui'/'Guaiba' fails; ids found via SWOT_L2_HR_RiverSP_reach_vD_Attributes FeatureServer bbox query on the AOI, ordered by dist_out via FTS /v1/rivers/reach/<id>. Hydrocron timeseries per reach.
